pages.name: onboarding-turnover
pages.after: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); await sleep(1500); const setv = (el, v) => { Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set.call(el, v); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); }; const pw = document.querySelectorAll('input[type=password]'); if (pw.length >= 2) { setv(pw[0], 'HubTurnoverCheck!2026'); setv(pw[1], 'HubTurnoverCheck!2026'); await sleep(200); document.querySelector('button[type=submit]').click(); await sleep(3000); } else if (pw.length === 1) { setv(pw[0], 'HubTurnoverCheck!2026'); await sleep(200); document.querySelector('button[type=submit]').click(); await sleep(3000); } for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) { const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open] button')].find(x => x.textContent.trim() === 'Not now'); if (b) { b.click(); await sleep(500); break; } await sleep(250); } const step = [...document.querySelectorAll('a,button')].find(e => /Business identity/.test(e.textContent)); if (step) { step.click(); await sleep(2500); } for (let i = 0; i < 40 && !document.querySelector('input[inputmode=decimal]'); i++) await sleep(250); const el = document.querySelector('input[inputmode=decimal]'); if (!el) return 'no-card:' + location.pathname + ':' + document.body.innerText.slice(0, 200); el.closest('section').scrollIntoView({block:'start'}); return 'value=' + el.value + ' | ' + el.closest('section').innerText.slice(0, 900); })()
